scope: Separate experimental extension; original article, learners, data and reports preserved

fixed.normalization: Original a priori component bounds; no empirical rescaling
fixed.safe_budget: Original certified 6 sqrt(K-1) h^(3/4), using actual fresh block length
fixed.first_action: Original uniform initialization, retained for all adapted fast variants
fixed.saddle_epsilon: rho / sqrt(local t), 0 <= rho <= 1; full historical hull and original witness/update, independently recomputed gap with fallback

validation.selection: For each family minimize mean native total loss over fixed validation bank and common paths; exact ties follow declared grid order
validation.lock: Write selection.json with validation inputs, scores, config and hashes before loading final bank or evaluating final outcomes

primary_test.ci: Approximate paired crossed percentile bootstrap of whole simulator seed tables and whole common paths, Bonferroni family of two; conditional on original calibration and validation-selected config
primary_test.advantage_rule: Upper simultaneous interval strictly below zero

restarts.uncertainty: Descriptive paired crossed 95% intervals, no additional primary superiority claims
restarts.semantics: One operation is a meta-round selecting a complete policy for a reset CAGE episode. Full state restart resets direction, residual E, safe mode, local clock; retain_history additionally preserves full past attack history/hull and scalar forecast history. Calibration always remains fixed.

inference.training_uncertainty: Excluded from primary intervals; no new calibration fits
inference.mixtures: Expected outcomes of whole independently reset policy episodes, not native action mixtures
inference.red_learning: Mode selection among three frozen policies, no new tactics
inference.safe_switching: Retain honest actual switch counts; novelty still bounded for known finite pure modes
